parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The application ID. To get this ID, call the [ListApplication](~~149390~~) operation.

parameters.name: ScalingBehaviour
parameters.description: The configuration for custom scaling behaviors. For more information about the data structure, see the example.

parameters.name: ScalingRuleEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the Auto Scaling rule.

- **true**: enables the rule.

- **false**: disables the rule.

parameters.name: ScalingRuleName
parameters.description: The name of the Auto Scaling rule. The name must start with a lowercase letter. It can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-). The name must be 1 to 32 characters long.

parameters.name: ScalingRuleTrigger
parameters.description: The trigger policy. Set this parameter to a JSON string of the ScalingRuleTriggerDTO object. For more information about the format, see Additional information about request parameters.

parameters.name: ScalingRuleType
parameters.description: The type of the Auto Scaling rule. Only the **trigger** type is supported.
